title: Essential p-dimension and Chern numbers
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth, projective, geometrically connected variety over a field $k$ containing a root of unity of order $p$. If $X$ has a Chern number prime to $p$, we show that every action of a finite $p$-group on $X$ factors through a subgroup of $\operatorname{GL}_n(k)$, where $n=\dim X$. This allows one to transfer properties of representations of finite $p$-groups to their actions on $X$. We deduce a fixed-point theorem which, unlike previously known results of this kind, is sensitive to the arithmetic of the base field.
